name: Nydine
personality: Exemplary, battle-proven warrior who earned Bonaventure's recognition.
story: Nydine is a 26-27-year-old Saraminian warrior recognised by Bonaventure. She left Saramis after the Gráinne War and settled in Dagda as a mercenary. Recruitment costs Bronze Axes (Cai/Dietrich) or Iron Axes (Theodora/Leda), with Leda's route the hardest at Renown 10.

personalSkill.name: Barge Through
personalSkill.effect: Cavalry can move through foes' spaces (not large-scale foes). Lv20: At a Gallop (terrain cost -1); Lv35: At a Gallop+ (terrain cost -2).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: B tier (Ornius rider who can move through enemy spaces). Pocket Tactics: B tier. Reddit: Armored Ornius Rider → Cataphract worked for some; others found her fragile and slow (disputed).

why: Lowest Support requirement of any route: 1 here vs Dietrich 2, Theodora 3, Leda 3.
recruit.tip: Only needs 2 Bronze Axes here instead of 3 Iron Axes.

build.role: Mounted axe flanker, then second flier
build.part1Target: Bench (Ornius Rider): recruit for Part II
build.notes: Joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class; benched in Part I. Arena Rider D, Flying C, Axe B, Spear B. Part II: Army Training to Lv 34 in Ornius Rider, Armored Ornius Rider in Ch 1, Dragoon in Ch 2 as the second flier, Bau Lord in Part III. The Wing Soldier detour and Sense Threat are gone.

guide.role: Mounted axe flanker, then second flier
guide.summary: Benched in Part I: Seteth holds the flier role (Dragoon in Ch 11 or 12), and every rank her Dragoon exam needs trains in the Arena. Flier is one of her preferred ranks, so after Army Training she becomes your second flier as a Dragoon in Part II Ch 2, in time for the Ranger chase.
guide.playstyle: Slip through enemy lines to hit healers and archers, then pull back. As a Dragoon her cavalry skills switch off: fly over terrain instead.
keys: Bench in Part I: Arena Mounted and Heavy Training for Rider D, Flying C, Axe B and Spear B.
Give her the Cindered Road Cave Flying Manual.
Equip Ji, Da Mina Axe, Hand Axe, Ridersbane and the Giant's Ring at the end of Ch 12.
Part II Ch 1: Armored Ornius Rider on a Red Meganius; Ch 2: Dragoon.
Catch a Wild Bau for her if Ch 12 allows.
watch: Spear is her weak rank: it gates Dragoon.
Res growth 25%: keep her away from mages.
If Flying C or Spear B is short by Part II, she stays Armored Ornius Rider and Seteth flies alone in Ch 2.

Weight: Da Mina Axe 10 (Silver Axe 9) against the Giant's Ring's Bld +4 (Wt 0, Avo -20): no shield in Parts I and II. Part III: Velheit 5 + Shield of Zephyrus 5 = 10 against Bld +4, so the shield nets 1 extra weight; drop it on maps without archers.
Inventory: Part II carries 5 (Da Mina Axe, Ji, Hand Axe, Giant's Ring, Concoction): one slot free for an issued Iron +3 weapon.

guide.role: Part II deep striker and rescue runner
guide.summary: Part II bench cavalry: Barge Through lets her ride through foe lines to an Onager crew, a fleeing Ranger or the escape tiles. She trains on the bench in Part I and fights Part II as a Cataphract with Pavise and Strike-Last Def +3. Keep her in a cavalry class, or the skill switches off.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: ride through the line (At a Gallop+ cuts terrain cost by 2), hit the archer or crew, end beside an ally on a forest. Enemy phase: Pavise and Strike-Last Def +3 take physical hits; stay out of mage range (Res 20 as Cataphract).
keys: Recruit her late Ch 7: Support 3, Renown 5, 3 Iron Axes
Book Arena Heavy every week: Axe, Spear, Heavy and Authority in one course
Clear Bonaventure's Ch 8 Send Supplies by 10/24: it unlocks Cataphract
Buy a [[item:Da Mina Axe]] at Axe C (Ch 9): +1 then, +2 at Renown 10 (Ch 12)
Take [[class:Cataphract]] on a Part II Ch 2 Advanced License
Never leave cavalry: Barge Through and At a Gallop+ switch off on foot
watch: Weight: Part II Da Mina Axe 10 + Talisman Shield 3 + Archer's Ring 3 = 16; Part III Bronze Axe +4 9 + Hexlock Shield 4 + 3 = 16 vs Bld ?. Shield off first on maps without mages.
Res: 25 growth, 20 as Cataphract, 15 as Great Knight. End turns outside mage range.
Hit: Da Mina Axe 65, arts +10; Spike, Axes Lv. N and the Archer's Ring carry it.
